text:
lina-sec: Heads-up — I pushed a draft change to how we separate SIEM export roles from general log-read roles. Goal: strict separation-of-duty for production audit exports and a short-lived, ticketed path for triage.
ashley-eng: can you paste the change? quick skim now.
lina-sec: Sure. Key bits:
- new role: exporter.role (can request/export scrubbed SIEM bundles)
- old "log-reader" remains, but no export perms
- retention policy enforced at export time: default 90d, legal-hold overrides allowed by sec/legal
- all exports must be encrypted with customer CMK via KMS proxy
lina-sec: snippet of proposed RBAC policy:
```json
{
  "role": "exporter.role",
  "permissions": ["siem:export:create", "siem:export:list"],
  "constraints": {"export_retention_days": 90, "kms_required": true}
}
```
paul_sre: :eyes: two questions — how do we ensure requesters can't just re-ingest exports into other systems? Any watermarking or access tags?
lina-sec: plan is to include an export metadata header with a signed provenance token and a policy tag that external tooling can use to reject imports without attestation. We'll also add an automated scanner that flags re-ingest patterns.
jorge-plat: about KMS: does "kms_required": true mean we force CMK wrap on export artifacts? who owns the key? ops or tenant?
lina-sec: For now, tenant CMKs for customer-owned exports; for internal investigations we use a central Redwood CMK with strict audit. The export flow will call the kms-proxy service which logs unwrap/rewrap ops.
ashley-eng: For vuln triage during incidents we often need faster access. Can we add an "expedited" path that is still auditable but reduces approval latency?
lina-sec: Yes — proposed expedited flow:
1) Oncall opens a SOC ticket referencing incident id
2) Pagerduty + 2FA approval from oncall + sec lead (both in Slack thread)
3) deploy-bot issues a timeboxed exporter token valid for max 4 hours
4) operations run export; every action recorded in audit-log with KM unwrap event
paul_sre: Sounds reasonable. We should limit the expedited token to specific dataset scopes and include a mandatory post-incident attestation form.
ashley-eng: Also request that the Console UI shows an "export justification" field and auto-attaches the ticket link. Minimizes human error.
lina-sec: Agreed. I've added a Console mockup link: https://internal.redwood/console/mockups/export-justification
jorge-plat: One nit: retention at export time is tricky when combined with legal hold. What's precedence? I suggest legal-hold supersedes any export TTL.
lina-sec: Legal-hold wins. I'll update the policy to include: "if legal_hold==true then retention_days = max(retention_days, legal_hold_days)" and make legal team the only one who can remove holds.
paul_sre: Can we add an automated notifier to sec-ops when a long export (>30d) is created? Could be a useful signal.
lina-sec: Done, will add webhook to send export metadata to sec-ops channel and to a retention-audit index in ES.
ashley-eng: One more — rolling key rotation. If we rewrap exports during key rotation, ensure we do not drop provenance tags and that rollback is possible for forensic teams.
jorge-plat: We'll model rotation as rewrap-with-preserve-metadata. I'll add a rotation checklist to the kms-proxy repo.
deploy-bot: deploy status: RBAC policy manifest pushed to branch "sec/exporter-role-v1" — 3/5 unit tests failing (policy constraints). Run `make policy-test` to reproduce.
ashley-eng: I'll take the test fixes this afternoon. Quick plan: lina, please update the doc with the expedited flow diagram I can implement. paul/jorge - can you review the KMS rotation checklist by EOD?
lina-sec: Will update doc and diagram now. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
paul_sre: ACK, will review KMS checklist.
jorge-plat: ACK, will PR checklist with rotation steps and test plan.
ashley-eng: tagging @legal for visibility: legal, FYI on the legal-hold precedence. Please shout if this needs tweaks.
lina-sec: tagging @legal:legal-team - heads up, will need your sign-off on legal-hold removal policy.
deploy-bot: reminder: remember to add entries to audit-index mapping before exporting large blobs."
